name: Starcoin Group Limited
summary: Operating as an investment holding company, Innovative Pharmaceutical Biotech Limited (IPBL) primarily engages in the distribution of beauty equipment and associated products across both mainland China and Hong Kong. The firm structures its operations into two key divisions: Trading of Beauty Products and Research and Development. Furthermore, IPBL's diversified activities include securities investments, the development and market introduction of oral insulin products, the provision of bio-industrial goods, and offering genetic screening services. The company rebranded to Innovative Pharmaceutical Biotech Limited in September 2015, having previously been known as United Gene High-Tech Group Limited. Its principal office is located in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
